requests.\nfn dispatch_post(\n    path: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    req: &str,\n    sessions: &mut HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> (u16, String) {\n    match path {\n        \"/v1/storage/reset\" => {\n            if let Err(e) = reset_db() {\n                eprintln!(\"reset storage failed: {}\", e);\n                (500, r#\"{\"error\":\"reset failed\"}\"#.to_string())\n            } else {\n                sessions.clear();\n                // Preserve registered user accounts across storage reset so that\n                // the authenticated play surface can still identify DMs/players\n                // established earlier in the cumulative test suite.\n                (200, r#\"{\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n        }\n        \"/v1/auth/register\" => match auth::handle_register(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (201, resp)\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate username\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/auth/login\" => match auth::handle_login(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => (200, resp),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::Unauthorized) => (401, r#\"{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}\"#.to_string()),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/dice/stats\" => option_response(dice::handle_dice_stats(body)),\n        \"/v1/checks/ability\" => requests.\nfn dispatch_post(\n    path: &str,\n    body: &str,\n    req: &str,\n    sessions: &mut HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> (u16, String) {\n    match path {\n        \"/v1/storage/reset\" => {\n            if let Err(e) = reset_db() {\n                eprintln!(\"reset storage failed: {}\", e);\n                (500, r#\"{\"error\":\"reset failed\"}\"#.to_string())\n            } else {\n                sessions.clear();\n                // Preserve registered user accounts across storage reset so that\n                // the authenticated play surface can still identify DMs/players\n                // established earlier in the cumulative test suite.\n                (200, r#\"{\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n        }\n        \"/v1/auth/register\" => match auth::handle_register(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (201, resp)\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate username\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(auth::RegisterError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/auth/login\" => match auth::handle_login(body, users) {\n            Ok(resp) => (200, resp),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::Unauthorized) => (401, r#\"{\"error\":\"unauthorized\"}\"#.to_string()),\n            Err(auth::LoginError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/dice/stats\" => option_response(dice::handle_dice_stats(body)),\n        \"/v1/checks/ability\" => option_response(dice::handle_ability_check(body)),\n        \"/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp\" => option_response(encounters::handle_encounter(body)),\n        \"/v1/initiative/order\" => option_response(combat::handle_initiative(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/ability-modifier\" => option_response(phb::handle_ability_modifier(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/proficiency\" => option_response(phb::handle_proficiency(body)),\n        \"/v1/characters/derived-stats\" => option_response(phb::handle_derived_stats(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/spell-slots\" => option_response(phb::handle_spell_slots(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/rests/long\" => option_response(phb::handle_long_rest(body)),\n        \"/v1/phb/equipment-load\" => option_response(phb::handle_equipment_load(body)),\n        \"/v1/combat/sessions\" => match combat::create_session(body, sessions) {\n            Some(resp) => {\n                let _ = save_storage(sessions, users);\n                (200, resp)\n            }\n            None => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/compendium/monsters\" => match compendium::handle_create_monster(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate NOT_FOUND.to_string()),\n        },\n        \"/v1/compendium/items\" => match compendium::handle_create_item(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate slug\"}\"#.to_string())\n            }\n            Err(compendium::CompendiumError::BadRequest) =>          (201, resp)\n                }\n                Err(play::PlayError::Conflict) => {\n                    (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate play campaign id\"}\"#.to_string())\n Err(play::PlayError::BadRequest) => (400, BAD_REQUEST.to_string()),\n            },\n            Err(e) => auth_error(e),\n        },\n        \"/v1/campaigns\" => match campaigns::create_campaign(body) {\n            Ok(resp) => (201, resp),\n            Err(campaigns::CampaignError::Conflict) => {\n                (409, r#\"{\"error\":\"duplicate campaign play_campaign_owner_status(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if owner != actor {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let (current_actor, phase, turn_number) =\n        play_campaign_get_turn(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if current_actor != \"dm\" || (phase != \"dm\" && phase != \"exploration\") {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n\n    let text = extract_string(body, \"text\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if text.is_empty() || actor.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let members = play_campaign_members(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    if members.is_empty() {\n        return Err(PlayError::Conflict);\n    }\n    let next_index = (turn_number % members.len() as i64) as usize;\n    let next_actor = members[next_index].0.clone();\n    let new_turn_number = turn_number + 1;\n\n    let sequence = play_narration_next_sequence(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_narration_create(campaign_id, sequence, \"resolution\", \"dm\", text)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    play_campaign_update_turn(campaign_id, &next_actor, \"player\", new_turn_number)\n        .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    Ok(format!(\n        r#\"{{\"sequence\":{},\"kind\":\"resolution\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"{}\",\"next_actor\":\"{}\",\"turn_number\":{}}}\"#,\n        sequence,\n        escape_json(text),\n        escape_json(&next_actor),\n        new_turn_number\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Parse a play campaign scene sub-resource path.\n///\n/// For example, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/scenes/{scene_id}/enter` migrate_play_currency_transfers_table()?;\n    migrate_play_loot_tables()?;\n    migrate_play_npcs_table()\n}\n\n/// Add a column to a table if it does not already exist.\n///\n/// `definition` must include the full column clause, e.g.\n/// `\"status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'\"`. This is used by the startup\n/// migrations to make older schemas forward-compatible without altering\n/// behavior for newly created databases.\nfn add_column_if_missing(table: &str, column: &str, definition: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\"PRAGMA table_info({});\", table);\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let has_column = extract_objects(content)\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|o| extract_string(o, \"name\"))\n        .any(|name| name == column);\n    if !has_column {\n        sqlite_exec(&format!(\"ALTER TABLE {} ADD COLUMN {};\", table, definition))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the death-saves stage lack `status`,\n/// `death_saves_successes`, and `death_saves_failures`. This is a destructive operation used by the storage reset endpoint.\npub fn reset_db() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_meta;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monsters;\n        DROP      DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_loot;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_loot_votes;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_npcs;\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)?;\n    init_db()\n}\n\n/// Return the current schema version and initialization flag.\n///\n/// If the schema_meta row is missing or the query fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing role\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM {} WHERE slug = '{}';\",\n        table,\n        sql_escape(slug)\n    );\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n    Ok(!output.trim().is_empty())\n}\n\npub fn owned by the authenticated DM.\npub fn play_campaign_create(\n    id: &str,\n    name: &str,\n    owner: &str,\n    status: &str,\n    max_players: i64,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = is inserted on demand and\n/// empty strings are returned.\npub fn play_campaign_document_get(id: &str) -> Result<(String, String), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"SELECT story, dm_notes FROM play_campaign_documents WHERE id = '{}';\",\n        sql_escape(id)\n    );\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let objects = extract_objects(content);\n    if objects.is_empty() {\n        let insert = format!(\n            \"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO play_campaign_documents (id, story, dm_notes) VALUES ('{}', '', '');\",\n            sql_escape(id)\n        );\n        sqlite_exec(&insert)?;\n        return Ok((String::new(), String::new()));\n    }\n    let story = extract_string(objects[0], \"story\").ok_or(\"missing story\")?;\n    let dm_notes = extract_string(objects[0], \"dm_notes\").ok_or(\"missing dm_notes\")?;\n    Ok((story.to_string(), dm_notes.to_string()))\n}\n\n/// Update the durable campaign document.\npub fn play_campaign_document_set(id: &str, story: &str, dm_notes: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"UPDATE play_campaign_documents SET story = '{}', dm_notes = '{}' WHERE id = '{}';\",\n        sql_escape(story),\n        sql_escape(dm_notes),\n        sql_escape(id)\n    );\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Return the maximum number of This is used by the startup\n/// migrations to make older schemas forward-compatible without altering\n/// behavior for newly created databases.\nfn add_column_if_missing(table: &str, column: &str, definition: &str) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = format!(\"PRAGMA table_info({});\", table);\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n\n    let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let has_column = extract_objects(content)\n        .into_iter()\n        .filter_map(|o| extract_string(o, \"name\"))\n        .any(|name| name == column);\n    if !has_column {\n        sqlite_exec(&format!(\"ALTER TABLE {} ADD COLUMN {};\", table, definition))?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Add missing death-save columns to an existing play_campaign_members table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the death-saves stage lack `status`,\n/// `death_saves_successes`, and `death_saves_failures`. This migration runs\n/// unconditionally on startup and adds any missing columns with safe defaults.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"status\",\n        \"status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'healthy'\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"death_saves_successes\",\n        \"death_saves_successes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )?;\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"death_saves_failures\",\n        \"death_saves_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0\",\n    )\n}\n\n/// Add a missing owner column to an existing play_campaign_members table and\n/// backfill existing rows so that every character is linked to its player\n/// identity.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the character-ownership stage lack `owner`.\n/// This migration runs unconditionally on startup and adds the missing column\n/// with an empty default, then sets the owner to the member actor for any row\n/// that does not yet have an owner.\nfn migrate_play_campaign_members_owner() -> Result<(), String> {\n    add_column_if_missing(\n        \"play_campaign_members\",\n        \"owner\",\n        \"owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\",\n    )?;\n    sqlite_exec(\"UPDATE play_campaign_members SET owner = actor WHERE owner = '';\")\n}\n\n/// Add missing reward columns to an existing play_encounters table.\n///\n/// Older schemas created before the encounter rewards stage lack\n/// `xp_awarded` and `rewards_awarded`. This is a destructive operation used by the storage reset endpoint.\npub fn reset_db() -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sql = r#\"\n        PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS schema_meta;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combat_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS monster_tags;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS items;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS events;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS npcs;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS factions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS quest_milestones;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS quests;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS characters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaigns;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS character_equipment;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_inventory;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS crafting_projects;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS session_attendance;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS session_agenda;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_sessions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaigns;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_members;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_narrations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_campaign_documents;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_scenes;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_locations;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_location_connections;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_monsters;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_combatants;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_conditions;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_order;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_encounter_loot;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_spells;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_prepared_spells;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_spell_slots;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_casts;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_concentration;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_inventory;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_character_equipment;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_currency_transfers;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_loot;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_loot_votes;\n        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS play_npcs;\n    \"#;\n    sqlite_exec(sql)?;\n    init_db()\n}\n\n/// Return the current schema version and initialization flag.\n///\n/// If the schema_meta row is missing or the query fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing role\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n                order,\n                conditions,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Persist the entire in-memory state to SQLite.\n///\n/// This function is intentionally simple: it deletes all rows from the mutable\n/// tables and re-inserts them from the in-memory caches. The busy timeout\n/// helps prevent conflicts with rapid sequential requests.\npub fn save_storage(\n    sessions: &std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut sql = String::from(\n        \"PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;\\nDELETE FROM conditions;\\nDELETE FROM combatants;\\nDELETE FROM combat_sessions;\\nDELETE FROM users;\\n\",\n    );\n\n    for user in users.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (username, role, password_hash) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}');\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&user.username),\n            sql_escape(&user.role),\n            sql_escape(&user.password_hash)\n        ));\n    }\n\n    for session in sessions.values() {\n        sql.push_str(&format!(\n            \"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES ('{}', {}, {});\\n\",\n            sql_escape(&session.id),\n            session.round,\n            session.turn_index\n        ));\n        for (position, c) in session.order.iter().enumerate() {\n            sql.push_str(&format!(\n                \"INSERT INTO combatants (session_id, name, score, dex, position) VALUES ('{}', '{}', {}, {}, {});\\n\",\n                sql_escape(&session.id),\n                sql_escape(&c.name),\n                c.score,\n                c.dex,\n                position\n            ));\n        }\n        for (target, list) in &session.conditions {\n            for c in list {\n                sql.push_str(&format!(\n                    \"INSERT INTO conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining) VALUES ('{}', '{}', '{}', {});\\n\",\n                    sql_escape(&session.id),\n                    sql_escape(target),\n                    sql_escape(&c.name),\n                    c.remaining\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    sqlite_exec(&sql)\n}\n\n/// Check whether a compendium slug already exists in the given table.\npub fn compendium_slug_exists(table: &str, slug: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {\n    let sql = format!(\n        \"SELECT 1 FROM {} WHERE slug = '{}';\",\n        table,\n        sql_escape(slug)\n    );\n    let output = sqlite_query(&sql)?;\n    Ok(!output.trim().is_empty())\n}\n\npub fn \"story\").ok_or(\"missing story\")?;\n    let dm_notes = extract_string(objects[0], \"dm_notes\").ok_or(\"missing dm_notes\")?;\n    Ok((story.to_string(), dm_notes.to_string()))\n}\n\n/// Update the .map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let mut by_target: std::collections::HashMap<String, Vec<(String, i64)>> =\n        std::collections::HashMap::new();\n    for (target, name, remaining) in
